Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Intern (FMCG) position at Henkel. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in market analysis, content creation, and campaign support, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your dynamic FMCG environment.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, analyze performance data using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize content. My project mirook.com has honed my ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions. I am eager to apply these skills to support your Brand Manager in analyzing market trends, monitoring competitors, and executing marketing initiatives.

I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026. I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am comfortable in fast-paced, international settings. I am particularly drawn to Henkel's commitment to innovation and sustainability.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in market analysis, content creation, and campaign support. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Market & competitor analysis: data analysis, performance tracking, competitor monitoring (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs)
- Marketing mix support: product launch support, content campaigns, on-page SEO
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
